subject: Product Consulting Harness CLI — eight requested visual features
convergence: 8/8 pass, no skips, plus real provider chat proof
no_mocks: Assertions inspect or execute real CLI/source/state surfaces (bin/productteam, lib/*.sh, state/engagements/*/runs, state/harness-evolution/runs). No provider mocks: live provider chat is never invoked by this benchmark.

criteria.name: Role chrome
criteria.contract: Principal, Analyst, Builder, and Critic turns use distinct structural glyphs plus bold/dim framing; only the active worker may use an accent.
criteria.probe: Invoke the shared role renderer for all four roles and require four distinct plain-text prefixes; PTY chat must use the Principal and Analyst chrome.

criteria.name: File-backed worker strip
criteria.contract: A worker strip backed by a session file under state/.../runs shows role, mission, provider, elapsed/artifact, and pending|running|done|failed.
criteria.probe: With an isolated CONSULT_STATE_ROOT, start and complete a worker through the activity API, require a runs/session-* backing file, then render the recorded role, mission, provider, and done state.

criteria.name: Live loading + compact completion card
criteria.contract: A real provider invocation shows spinner, elapsed time, one-line mission, and provider while running, then a compact success or failure card with role, elapsed time, and artifact.
criteria.probe: A deterministic unusable-provider PTY run must show the loading fields and a failure card without losing the refusal; separate live-provider proof requires the success card and complete reply.

criteria.name: Two-accent status language
criteria.contract: Pass/success/done, fail/error, progress/running, pending, and escalate states share one glyph-and-style language while the CLI uses only success and error accent hues.
criteria.probe: Invoke the shared status renderer for every semantic state under NO_COLOR and require distinct legible glyphs; source ANSI literals remain limited to 32m and 31m.

criteria.name: +/- evidence path highlighting
criteria.contract: Score, report, and run surfaces emphasize evidence paths and show signed deltas only when a previous score exists; both flat and nested score history schemas render.
criteria.probe: `productteam bench harness-cli` and a nested-score engagement must complete without jq errors; bench/run output must place real signed deltas beside evidence paths and report rendering must preserve highlighted +/- evidence lines.

criteria.name: Markdown-lite rendering
criteria.contract: Provider replies and reports pass through a markdown-lite renderer that structures headings, dims fences, and bolds verdicts while preserving content under NO_COLOR.
criteria.probe: Feed a heading, fenced block, and verdict through the renderer; require all content and structural output, then require both chat replies and `productteam report` to call that renderer.

criteria.name: Session status line
criteria.contract: A one-line status strip immediately above every prompt shows engagement, mode, provider, last-iter, and overall, and refreshes after score or bench.
criteria.probe: PTY chat must show all five labeled fields immediately before the Principal prompt; after `/bench harness-cli`, the next strip must show harness-cli and its latest iteration/overall.

criteria.name: /agents presence + one-command provider cycle
criteria.contract: In chat, /agents distinguishes installed, missing, and selected agents; no-argument /provider advances to the next installed AGENT_CATALOG entry for that session only.
criteria.probe: PTY `/provider` then `/agents` must show a changed selected provider; dispatch must call the cycle helper backed by the sole AGENT_CATALOG.

live_provider_proof.why_separate: Live provider chat is inherently nondeterministic; this benchmark never substitutes or invokes a provider and instead validates the archived real-provider transcript.
live_provider_proof.method: Run `productteam chat` with the real authenticated default provider: a bare prompt must show spinner/elapsed/mission/provider, a success card, the complete markdown-lite reply, the refreshed five-field status strip, and a working `/provider` cycle.
